sanguine.name: Reckless Abandon
sanguine.desc: Level 40 PassiveEach stack of Thirst now increases your critical strike chance by 1%.

sanguine.name: Crimson Terror
sanguine.desc: Your Transgression now grants spell damage equal to 50% of your Spirit for the duration.

sanguine.name: Blood Banquet
sanguine.desc: Increases the damage of Valanar's Vengeance and Taldaram's Torment by 15%. (up to 2 ranks)

sanguine.name: Twisted Magic
sanguine.desc: Your direct harmful critical strikes increase the target's Shadow damage taken from you by 2%, stacking up to 5 times, for 12 seconds.

sanguine.name: Fearmonger
sanguine.desc: Increases the tick rate and cost of Taldaram's Torment by -30%.

sanguine.name: Atherann's Anguish
sanguine.desc: Unleash a hemoplague upon the target area, accumulating 30% of the damage you deal to affected enemies for 10 seconds, and then exploding for that amount of Shadow damage.Damage caused by this ability cannot critically strike.

sanguine.name: Agonizing Pain
sanguine.desc: Damage dealt by your Atherann's Anguish now causes enemies hit to bleed, dealing shadow SP Shadow damage over 10 seconds.

sanguine.name: The Council Assembled
sanguine.desc: Atherann's Anguish now costs -25 less Rage.Taldaram's Torment now increases the damage of your next Valanar's Vengeance or Keleseth's Calamity by 3% per tick for 10 seconds, stacking 5 times.Valanar's Vengeance and Keleseth's Calamity now reduce the cooldown of Malediction by -5 sec.

sanguine.name: Essence Harvester
sanguine.desc: Being struck by an enemy while below 35% health instantly resets the cooldown of your Vampiric Fang and grants you Wretched.Can only occur once per minute.WretchedGenerates 10 Rage and 1 stack of Thirst every 1 sec for 10 seconds. Vampiric Fang removes this effect.

sanguine.name: Lifedrinker
sanguine.desc: Increases the damage of your Vampiric Fang by 25%.

sanguine.name: Vampyr Lord
sanguine.desc: Increases the damage dealt by your Animated Blood by 35%.

sanguine.name: Enthraller
sanguine.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of Valanar's Vengeance and Keleseth's Calamity by 10%.

sanguine.name: Blood Parasites
sanguine.desc: Your Taldaram's Torment now generates 3 additional Rage per tick and increases spell critical strike chance against the target by 3% for 15 seconds.

sanguine.name: Blood Craving
sanguine.desc: Requires Mortal FormYou crave blood for 12 seconds, for the duration you cannot be interrupted or silenced, and you regain 5% of your maximum health and 15% of your missing Rage every 2 sec.

sanguine.name: Keleseth's Calamity
sanguine.desc: Requires Mortal FormBend blood in an area, dealing shadow SP Shadow damage to enemies.Each stack of Thirst reduces the cast time of this ability and increases its damage.

sanguine.name: Cardiac Arrest
sanguine.desc: Your Valanar's Vengeance now deals an additional 50% of its initial damage dealt over 10 seconds, healing you for 50% of the damage dealt.

sanguine.name: Torture
sanguine.desc: Increases the leech of Vampiric Feast by 50%.Consuming at least 9 stacks of Thirst with Vampiric Fang now extends the duration of Transgression by 5 sec.

sanguine.name: Malediction
sanguine.desc: Condemn an enemy, dealing shadow SP Shadow damage over 12 seconds and increasing the damage they take from your next 5 direct damage spells by 20%.

sanguine.name: Blood Constructor
sanguine.desc: Increases the duration of Animated Blood by 1 sec per stack of Thirst.

sanguine.name: Bloodsores
sanguine.desc: (see builder tooltip)

sanguine.name: Night Feast
sanguine.desc: Each point of Rage now increases the damage of Bloodbolt by 1%, but its Rage cost is increased by 10.

sanguine.name: Thirst for Blood
sanguine.desc: (see builder tooltip)

sanguine.name: Atherann's Wickedness
sanguine.desc: Increases your Shadow damage dealt by 4% and increases your hit chance by 3%. (up to 2 ranks)

sanguine.name: Aneurysm
sanguine.desc: Counter the enemy's spellcast, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 4 seconds. Successfully interrupting an enemy heals you for 5% of your maximum health.

sanguine.name: Sacrificial Rite
sanguine.desc: Requires Mortal FormInvoke a dark ritual, increasing your haste by 20% for 15 seconds.While active, attackers are afflicted with Cursed Blood. Can only occur once per sec.At the end of the duration, your healing done is increased by 15% and you are healed for SP over 15 seconds.

sanguine.name: Valanar's Vengeance
sanguine.desc: Requires Mortal FormLaunch a powerful blood bolt at an enemy, dealing SP Shadow damage.Each stack of Thirst reduces the cast time of this ability and increases its damage.

sanguine.name: Hematoma
sanguine.desc: Your Bloodbolt now heals for an additional 20% of the damage dealt. (up to 2 ranks)

sanguine.name: Dark Presence
sanguine.desc: Increases spell haste of all party and raid members by 3%. Does not stack with similar effects.In addition, increases your spell haste by 3%.

sanguine.name: Dominion of Blood
sanguine.desc: Your Vampiric Fang now heals you for an additional 50% of the damage dealt.

sanguine.name: Transgression
sanguine.desc: (see builder tooltip)

sanguine.name: Darkfallen's Embrace
sanguine.desc: Increases your spell haste by 3% and increases the range of your Sanguine spells and Bloodbolt by 5 yds. (up to 2 ranks)

sanguine.name: The Cup Runneth Over
sanguine.desc: Increases the spell power scaling of Bloodmoon Blast, Taldaram's Torment and Bloodbolt by 20%.

sanguine.name: Blood Lord
sanguine.desc: Grants your Bloodsore a -15% chance to provide its benefits without being consumed. (up to 2 ranks)

sanguine.name: Bloodwell Eruption
sanguine.desc: Increases the radius of Sanguine Rupture by 5 yds and its critical strike chance by 10%.

sanguine.name: Cursed Ground
sanguine.desc: Increases the cast time of Sanguine Rupture by 2 sec, but now when you strike at least 5 enemies it causes them to bleed out, dealing an additional 352 Shadow damage over 2 seconds.

sanguine.name: Blood Prince's Command
sanguine.desc: Your Bloodbolt is now guaranteed to critically strike on enemies affected by Taldaram's Torment.

sanguine.name: Swarm of Flies
sanguine.desc: Your Bloodbolt now refreshes the duration of Taldaram's Torment.
